candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment to betLimit so the function emits the event but never updates state.
Assign a constant value instead of the input parameter, so betLimit changes but not to the caller-supplied amount.
Assign amount + 1 so betLimit is always one more than the input.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can change betLimit, changing the observable guard on AdjustBetAmounts.
Replace difficulty = amount; with difficulty = amount + 1; so the stored difficulty always differs from the argument.
Replace difficulty = amount; with difficulty = amount * 2; so the stored difficulty is doubled.
Delete the assignment difficulty = amount; so the difficulty state variable is never updated.
Change require(msg.sender == owner) to require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can call AdjustDifficulty, changing who can update difficulty.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, allowing anyone to call AdjustDifficulty and set difficulty.
Delete the onlyOwner() modifier from OpenToThePublic, making it callable by anyone.
Replace 'openToPublic = true;' with 'openToPublic = false;', inverting the state change.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any caller to pass the modifier check.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the access control.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(false), making the modifier always revert.
Remove the require statement inside onlyOwner, making the modifier do nothing and allowing anyone to call AdjustBetAmounts.
Change the require condition to always fail, preventing AdjustBetAmounts from ever executing.
Remove the assignment to betLimit, so AdjustBetAmounts emits the event but does not change the stored value.
Assign a constant value instead of the parameter, causing betLimit to always become 0 after the call.
Replace `difficulty = amount;` with `difficulty = amount + 1;` to change the stored difficulty value.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` statement to allow anyone to call `AdjustDifficulty` and change the difficulty.
Delete the `difficulty = amount;` assignment so that calling `AdjustDifficulty` does not change the difficulty state.
Replace `difficulty = amount;` with `difficulty = 0;` so the stored difficulty is always set to zero.
Replace 'wagers[msg.sender] = msg.value' with 'wagers[msg.sender] = 0' so that after wager succeeds, the mapping value is 0 instead of the sent amount.
Replace 'wagers[msg.sender] = msg.value' with 'wagers[msg.sender] = 1' so that after wager succeeds, the mapping value is 1 wei instead of the full bet amount.
Delete the assignment 'wagers[msg.sender] = msg.value' so that after wager succeeds, the mapping value remains 0.

Replace 'wagers[msg.sender] = msg.value' with 'wagers[tx.origin] = msg.value' so that after wager succeeds, the mapping value is stored under tx.origin instead of msg.sender (observable when called via a contract).
Replace 'require(msg.sender == tx.origin)' with 'require(true)' so that contracts can call wager and potentially bypass onlyRealPeople, changing wagers mapping for an EOA using a contract wallet.
Delete the require statement in onlyRealPeople modifier so that contracts can call wager and potentially change the wagers mapping for an EOA via a contract.
Replace 'require(openToPublic)' with 'require(!openToPublic)' so that wager can only be called when not open to public, preventing normal open calls from writing to the wagers mapping.
Delete the require statement in isOpenToPublic modifier so that wager can be called even when closed, changing the wagers mapping earlier than expected.
